name: Encroaching Wildlife
summary: After Lost Ones wreck Watcher Biggs's caravan, wild creatures prowl near his camp. Biggs alone survives and asks you to help defend the supplies that remain. This follows Help Watcher Biggs.

sections.title: A Camp Under Watch
sections.body: Watcher Biggs's caravan set out for the eastern coast, but never arrived. Lost Ones attacked, killing the guards and smashing the supplies. Biggs alone survived, and he has sworn to protect what remains. Now wild creatures skulk near the camp, and Biggs asks you to help defend it.

sections.title: The Creatures Nearby
sections.body: Young sawtooth crocolisks, sorrow spinners and swamp jaguars press close to the camp. Biggs names eight crocolisks, ten spinners and ten jaguars to be slain.

faq.q: Where was Watcher Biggs's caravan traveling?
faq.answer: Watcher Biggs's caravan was bound for the eastern coast, but it never arrived.
Lost Ones attacked the caravan, killing the guards and smashing the supplies. Watcher Biggs alone survived.
Young sawtooth crocolisks, sorrow spinners and swamp jaguars skulk near the camp.

faq.q: Why does Watcher Biggs remain at the camp?
faq.answer: Watcher Biggs has sworn to protect the supplies that remain from the caravan.
